Overview:

A new VR game taking the world by storm.
A new reality players are eager to explore…
At the heart of the story is a couple of students whose lives seem ordinar,
until a mysterious VR game called WE enters the picture.
A game that offers limitless freedom… and the chance to do things no one would dare attempt in the real world.
How will this game change them?
Will it push them to become someone else—or will they survive the challenge and protect what they have?
The choice is yours.​
